title: Common Cold & Viral Rhinitis — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
content:
Condition: Common Cold (Viral Rhinitis) and Nasal Allergy.
Allopathic Pharmacology (CDSCO/WHO Tier 1): Cetirizine 10mg once daily at bedtime for runny nose, sneezing, and watery eyes (H1 receptor antagonist). Pseudoephedrine or Phenylephrine decongestants. Paracetamol 500mg if mild fever or headache is present.
Ayurvedic Formulations (AYUSH Tier 3): Sitopaladi Churna (3g twice daily with honey) to soothe respiratory tract and clear Kapha. Talisadi Churna. Anu Taila (2 drops in each nostril in morning for Nasya).
Home Remedies & Supportive Care: Steam inhalation with Eucalyptus oil or Ajwain (5-10 mins twice daily), Warm water gargles, Tulsi Ginger Honey tea, Turmeric Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh) before sleep.
Precautions: Cetirizine may cause mild sedation. Avoid pseudoephedrine in severe hypertension.
